Run and Bun · Trainer Sheet

Every Trainer
In The Run

All 436 trainers and 1,832 Pokémon, in play order, split by badge and then by route. Each card is the set as the game runs it: species, level, held item, ability, nature and moves.

  • 680 distinct species across the run, from Route 102 to the Pokémon League.
  • Teams only. No EVs, no computed stats, no AI commentary — just what each trainer brings.
  • Move power is the standard value for that move; Run and Bun retunes a few.
  • Data from rnb_trainers.json; rebuild with build_rnb_doc2.py.
